experiments.scope: Constructibility of the variant dense parts and detection by the counted program (proof.md Sections 4.3, 7 and 13.2): it supports H2 only by showing that variants reach full 37-step semi-free-start collisions, and H4 only through the cost of completing a Step-1 solution; it estimates no probability. experiments/lowm.py rebuilds S, L* and the 222 embedded classes (the largest classes of the family G) from their descriptors; trials 0..127 each use class (7 t mod 222) (128 distinct classes), choose (from SHAKE-256 of the seed) a variant a0 of it, impose pattern t mod 8 (0..3: E16[23] = 0, a pattern of rows 18/19, l in the 28 that hold row 16; 4..7: R16x, E16[23] = 1, any l; proof.md 7.4c, 7.6), and build a 37-step semi-free-start collision whose second-block state uses the variant (rows 16..21 by proposals with each row's fixed x-bits of E imposed, restarting from row 16 after 2^11 proposals at a row; row 22 by W22 proposals with its x-cells and two-bit conditions imposed, W7 drawn exactly from F7, W6 = W22 - s1(W20) - W15 - s0(W7) accepted iff in F6; rows 22..36 with the variant's W8; W0..W5 by the inverse expansion; CV1 by inverting steps 7..0). A trial returns CV1||M1 and CV1||M1' (96 bytes each) iff: the Step-2 equations of (CV1, a0) give exactly W0..W13 of both members, the two 37-step outputs are equal, M1 != M1', every cell of rows -4..36 (W6/W7 XOR cells excepted) and every printed two-bit condition of rows 8..36 holds, a0 is in G and in its class, and W8 differs from the published one. In addition, for trials 0..15 the constructed chaining value is fed to the counted online program of this filing with the class test restricted to the class of a0 (the W6 tests of all reps of its list in all runs, the expansion of the cube, the gather, the packed address, the two-table probe, the exact row-16 test, rows 16..36), which must find exactly the constructed pair (observation detected_by_counted_program). Trials 128..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: about 128 (a trial can fail only by exhausting its proposal budget). Full collisions of the complete target: 0 (these are semi-free-start collisions from CV1, not from the IV; anyone can verify them offline with the 37-step compression). This tests that A0-variants of S (proof.md Lemmas 4.2, 4.3) are valid dense parts that reach full 37-step semi-free-start collisions through every cell of rows 16..36 with their own W8 (Lemma 7.1), for each of the four accepted value patterns of rows 18 and 19 and each of the four R16x patterns of rows 16..19, and that the counted program of this filing finds exactly the constructed pair. It does not estimate q3. Observations (participant numbers): class_index, variant_index, l, pattern, checks_passed, restarts, proposals_row16, proposals_tail. detected_by_counted_program = 1 and counted_ops (operations counted for that detection) for all returned pairs of trials 0..15.

experiments.scope: Functional exactness only: H5, Lemmas 6.2, 8.1 and 8.2 (proof.md Sections 6, 8, 9 and 13.2); a consistency check, not a test, of H1. The counted online program (proof.md Section 8.2) on seed-drawn first blocks (two uniform words from SHAKE-256 of the seed per first block; real 37-step compressions) with all 222 classes, until a first block has a passing class (at most 64 first blocks), restricted to the first three passing classes of that block for time: the W7 class test of all 222 classes, the W6 programs of every run, the scan, the cube expansion, the packed addresses, the two-table probe and the exact row-16 test of every probed lane, rows 17..36 for every row-16 pass. Every lane of the class-test plane is checked against the scalar F7 test, every lane of every pass plane against the scalar F6 test of the member (rep xor cube combination), the set of good pairs against the brute-force definition over all variants of the processed classes, the address u of every probed lane against W0 + s0(W1) from the step equations, the table stage and the exact test against the row-16 definition (every lane with a survivor and every 16th lane, for all 32 l), and up to 12 good pairs against every cell of rows -4..15 for all 32 elements of L*. A trial returns the complete 128-byte messages M0||M1 and M0||M1' (l = 13) of its first good pair iff all checks passed. Trials 8..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Full collisions: 0 (rows 16..36 are not expected to hold). Mismatches of every kind: 0. Returned pairs: those trials whose first block with a passing class had a good pair. Observations (participant numbers): first_blocks, classes, good_pairs, groups, survivors, row16_pairs, counted_ops, class_lane_mismatches, pass_lane_mismatches, goodset_mismatches, address_mismatches, row16_mismatches, cell_mismatches, pairs_cell_checked. This tests the correctness of the bit-sliced class and W6 programs, of the cube expansion (Lemma 8.2), of the packed address and of the row-16 stage (Lemma 6.2) on organizer-seeded first blocks; it does not test q3, H1 at scale or H3.
